reason: A named independent lab and a batch report I can open before I pay is exactly what I check for, and 200 mg of bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, not two.
objection: I only believe the testing once I open the report and see the lab name and that the batch number matches. Globally sourced ingredients also makes me wonder where the magnesium actually comes from.
would_change_my_mind: If the report on the page was missing, generic, or the batch number did not match the box, I would not buy.
